hook.en: Every law in Malaysia — from traffic rules to school rules — must obey one document. If a law goes against it, the law is invalid. What is in this supreme document?
hook.bm: Setiap undang-undang di Malaysia — daripada peraturan jalan raya hingga peraturan sekolah — mesti mematuhi satu dokumen. Jika sesuatu undang-undang bercanggah dengannya, undang-undang itu terbatal. Apakah kandungan dokumen tertinggi ini?

bigIdeas.en: The Constitution is the supreme law of the country (Article 4).
It was drafted by the Reid Commission after considering the views of many groups, including the Alliance.
bigIdeas.bm: Ia dirangka oleh Suruhanjaya Reid selepas menimbang pandangan pelbagai pihak, termasuk Perikatan.

bigIdeas.en: Key features: constitutional monarchy, parliamentary democracy, Islam, Malay language, Malay special position and citizenship.
bigIdeas.bm: Ciri utama: raja berperlembagaan, demokrasi berparlimen, Islam, bahasa Melayu, kedudukan istimewa Melayu dan kewarganegaraan.

detail.en: Religion of the Federation; others free (Art. 3)
Malays (and later natives of Sabah & Sarawak) (Art. 153)
By operation of law, registration, naturalisation
detail.bm: Melalui kuat kuasa undang-undang, pendaftaran, penaturalisasian

definition.en: The supreme set of laws on how a country is governed and the rights of its people.
definition.bm: Undang-undang tertinggi tentang cara negara diperintah dan hak rakyatnya.

definition.en: The king acts according to the constitution, usually on the advice of the government.
definition.bm: Raja bertindak mengikut perlembagaan, biasanya atas nasihat kerajaan.

definition.en: People elect representatives to Parliament, which forms the government.
definition.bm: Rakyat memilih wakil ke Parlimen, yang membentuk kerajaan.

definition.en: Power divided between legislature, executive and judiciary.
definition.bm: Kuasa dibahagikan antara badan perundangan, eksekutif dan kehakiman.

definition.en: Inter-ethnic agreement behind the Constitution's compromises.
definition.bm: Persetujuan antara kaum di sebalik tolak ansur dalam Perlembagaan.

definition.en: Basic rights such as freedom of religion and speech, within limits.
definition.bm: Hak asas seperti kebebasan beragama dan bersuara, dalam batasan.

question.en: Explain the importance of the Constitution to a multiracial society. (4 marks)
question.bm: Jelaskan kepentingan Perlembagaan kepada masyarakat berbilang kaum. (4 markah)

steps.en: Point 1: it guarantees fundamental liberties, e.g. freedom of religion for all.
steps.bm: Isi 1: menjamin kebebasan asasi, cth. kebebasan beragama untuk semua.

steps.en: Point 2: it records the inter-ethnic compromise, which keeps harmony and stability.
steps.bm: Isi 2: merekodkan tolak ansur antara kaum, yang mengekalkan keharmonian dan kestabilan.

answer.en: Always link the feature (what) to its effect on society (why it matters).
answer.bm: Sentiasa kaitkan ciri (apa) dengan kesannya kepada masyarakat (mengapa penting).

prompt.en: Who led the independence mission to London in 1956?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang mengetuai rombongan kemerdekaan ke London pada 1956?

explanation.en: Tunku Abdul Rahman led the mission of the rulers' and Alliance representatives.
explanation.bm: Tunku Abdul Rahman mengetuai rombongan wakil raja-raja dan Perikatan.

prompt.en: The London Agreement was signed on…
prompt.bm: Perjanjian London ditandatangani pada…

explanation.en: Britain agreed to independence on 31 August 1957 if possible.
explanation.bm: Britain bersetuju memberi kemerdekaan pada 31 Ogos 1957 jika boleh.

prompt.en: Select ALL members of the 1956 London mission.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA anggota rombongan London 1956.

explanation.en: The mission had four rulers' representatives and four Alliance representatives, led by Tunku.
explanation.bm: Rombongan terdiri daripada empat wakil raja dan empat wakil Perikatan, diketuai Tunku.

prompt.en: What was the MOST important factor that convinced Britain to grant independence?
prompt.bm: Apakah faktor PALING penting yang meyakinkan Britain memberi kemerdekaan?

explanation.en: Unity proved the country could govern itself peacefully.
explanation.bm: Perpaduan membuktikan negara mampu memerintah sendiri dengan aman.

options.en: Inter-ethnic unity shown by the Alliance's strong election win
options.bm: Perpaduan kaum yang ditunjukkan oleh kemenangan besar Perikatan

options.en: A war between Malaya and Britain
options.bm: Perang antara Tanah Melayu dan Britain

prompt.en: Where did Tunku first announce the date of independence?
prompt.bm: Di manakah Tunku mula-mula mengumumkan tarikh kemerdekaan?

explanation.en: He announced it on 20 February 1956 after returning from London.
explanation.bm: Beliau mengumumkannya pada 20 Februari 1956 selepas pulang dari London.

prompt.en: Why was Melaka chosen for the first announcement?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Melaka dipilih untuk pengumuman pertama?

explanation.en: Announcing freedom where colonisation began was symbolic.
explanation.bm: Mengumumkan kebebasan di tempat bermulanya penjajahan amat simbolik.

options.en: It was the historic centre of the Malay Sultanate, which fell to the Portuguese in 1511
options.bm: Melaka pusat bersejarah Kesultanan Melayu yang jatuh ke tangan Portugis pada 1511

options.en: It was the only city with a stadium
It was the capital of Japan

prompt.en: The commission that drafted the 1957 Constitution was led by Lord ______.
prompt.bm: Suruhanjaya yang merangka Perlembagaan 1957 diketuai oleh Lord ______.

explanation.en: The Reid Commission was formed in 1956.
explanation.bm: Suruhanjaya Reid dibentuk pada 1956.

prompt.en: Match each Reid Commission member with his country.
prompt.bm: Padankan ahli Suruhanjaya Reid dengan negaranya.

explanation.en: Sir Ivor Jennings from Britain was the fifth member.
explanation.bm: Sir Ivor Jennings dari Britain ialah ahli kelima.

prompt.en: How many memoranda did the Reid Commission receive?
prompt.bm: Berapakah memorandum yang diterima Suruhanjaya Reid?

explanation.en: It studied 131 memoranda, including one from the Alliance.
explanation.bm: Ia meneliti 131 memorandum, termasuk satu daripada Perikatan.

prompt.en: Why was the Reid Commission made up of members from Commonwealth countries, not Malaya?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Suruhanjaya Reid dianggotai ahli dari negara Komanwel, bukan Tanah Melayu?

explanation.en: Outside experts were seen as fair to all groups.
explanation.bm: Pakar luar dianggap adil kepada semua pihak.

options.en: Because Malaya had no educated people
options.bm: Kerana Tanah Melayu tiada orang berpelajaran

prompt.en: The commission that drafted the 1957 Constitution was the ______ Commission.
prompt.bm: Suruhanjaya yang merangka Perlembagaan 1957 ialah Suruhanjaya ______.

explanation.en: Led by Lord Reid, it worked in 1956–1957.
explanation.bm: Diketuai Lord Reid, ia bekerja pada 1956–1957.

prompt.en: Why did the Reid Commission consider the Alliance memorandum important?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Suruhanjaya Reid menganggap memorandum Perikatan penting?

explanation.en: The Alliance memorandum recorded the inter-ethnic compromise (social contract).
explanation.bm: Memorandum Perikatan merekodkan tolak ansur antara kaum (kontrak sosial).

options.en: It reflected an agreement already reached between the main ethnic parties
options.bm: Ia mencerminkan persetujuan yang telah dicapai antara parti-parti kaum utama

options.en: It was written by the British

prompt.en: Arrange the making of the Constitution in order.
prompt.bm: Susun proses penggubalan Perlembagaan mengikut urutan.

prompt.en: The Federation of Malaya Agreement 1957 was signed on…
prompt.bm: Perjanjian Persekutuan Tanah Melayu 1957 ditandatangani pada…

explanation.en: It was signed by the Malay rulers and High Commissioner Sir Donald MacGillivray.
explanation.bm: Ia ditandatangani oleh raja-raja Melayu dan Pesuruhjaya Tinggi Sir Donald MacGillivray.

prompt.en: Which body studied and amended the Reid Report before it was approved?
prompt.bm: Badan manakah yang mengkaji dan meminda Laporan Reid sebelum diluluskan?

explanation.en: After the Working Committee, the draft was approved in London and by the Conference of Rulers, the Federal Legislative Council and the British Parliament.
explanation.bm: Selepas Jawatankuasa Kerja, draf diluluskan di London dan oleh Majlis Raja-Raja, Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan serta Parlimen British.

options.en: A Working Committee of the rulers, the Alliance and the British
options.bm: Jawatankuasa Kerja wakil raja-raja, Perikatan dan British

prompt.en: The "social contract" (kontrak sosial) during independence talks refers to…
prompt.bm: "Kontrak sosial" semasa rundingan kemerdekaan merujuk kepada…

explanation.en: Non-Malays received citizenship; Malay special position, Islam and Malay were enshrined.
explanation.bm: Bukan Melayu menerima kerakyatan; kedudukan istimewa Melayu, Islam dan bahasa Melayu dimaktubkan.

options.en: Give-and-take between races on citizenship, Malay special rights, language and religion
options.bm: Tolak ansur antara kaum tentang kerakyatan, hak istimewa Melayu, bahasa dan agama

prompt.en: Which Article states that the Constitution is the supreme law?
prompt.bm: Perkara manakah menyatakan Perlembagaan ialah undang-undang tertinggi?

explanation.en: Article 4: any law inconsistent with the Constitution is void.
explanation.bm: Perkara 4: undang-undang yang bercanggah dengan Perlembagaan terbatal.

prompt.en: Article 3 of the Constitution is about…
prompt.bm: Perkara 3 Perlembagaan berkaitan dengan…

explanation.en: Islam is the religion of the Federation; other religions may be practised in peace and harmony.
explanation.bm: Islam agama Persekutuan; agama lain boleh diamalkan dengan aman dan damai.

options.en: Islam as the religion of the Federation

prompt.en: Article 152 is about…
prompt.bm: Perkara 152 berkaitan dengan…

explanation.en: Malay is the national language; other languages may be used and taught.
explanation.bm: Bahasa Melayu bahasa kebangsaan; bahasa lain boleh digunakan dan diajar.

prompt.en: The special position of the Malays is protected under Article ______.
prompt.bm: Kedudukan istimewa orang Melayu dilindungi di bawah Perkara ______.

explanation.en: Article 153 — later extended to the natives of Sabah and Sarawak.
explanation.bm: Perkara 153 — kemudian diperluas kepada bumiputera Sabah dan Sarawak.

prompt.en: Who was the first Yang di-Pertuan Agong?
prompt.bm: Siapakah Yang di-Pertuan Agong pertama?

explanation.en: Tuanku Abdul Rahman ibni Almarhum Tuanku Muhammad of Negeri Sembilan.
explanation.bm: Tuanku Abdul Rahman ibni Almarhum Tuanku Muhammad dari Negeri Sembilan.

prompt.en: Malaysia's system of government is…
prompt.bm: Sistem pemerintahan Malaysia ialah…

explanation.en: The king reigns according to the Constitution; elected representatives govern.
explanation.bm: Raja memerintah mengikut Perlembagaan; wakil rakyat yang dipilih mentadbir.

options.en: Parliamentary democracy with a constitutional monarchy

prompt.en: Which body elects the Yang di-Pertuan Agong?
prompt.bm: Badan manakah yang memilih Yang di-Pertuan Agong?

explanation.en: The Conference of Rulers elects the King for five years.
explanation.bm: Majlis Raja-Raja memilih Yang di-Pertuan Agong untuk tempoh lima tahun.

prompt.en: Match each Article with its content.
prompt.bm: Padankan Perkara dengan kandungannya.

explanation.en: These four Articles are the most examined.
explanation.bm: Empat Perkara ini paling kerap disoal.

prompt.en: Select ALL ways to gain citizenship under the Constitution.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA cara memperoleh kewarganegaraan di bawah Perlembagaan.

explanation.en: Buying land does not give citizenship.
explanation.bm: Membeli tanah tidak memberi kewarganegaraan.

prompt.en: Separation of powers divides power among…
prompt.bm: Pengasingan kuasa membahagikan kuasa antara…

explanation.en: Each branch checks the others to prevent abuse of power.
explanation.bm: Setiap badan mengimbangi yang lain untuk mengelak penyalahgunaan kuasa.

prompt.en: "Other religions may be practised in peace and harmony" shows which value?
prompt.bm: "Agama lain boleh diamalkan dengan aman dan damai" menunjukkan nilai apa?

explanation.en: Freedom of religion is a fundamental liberty (Article 11).
explanation.bm: Kebebasan beragama ialah kebebasan asasi (Perkara 11).

prompt.en: Which is an importance of the Constitution?
prompt.bm: Apakah kepentingan Perlembagaan?

explanation.en: It is the framework for government and the guarantee of rights.
explanation.bm: Ia rangka pemerintahan dan jaminan hak.

options.en: It protects citizens' rights and guides how the country is governed
options.bm: Melindungi hak rakyat dan menjadi panduan pemerintahan negara

options.en: It lets leaders ignore the law
It gives power to foreign countries

prompt.en: What is the first principle of the Rukun Negara that relates closely to Article 3?
prompt.bm: Prinsip pertama Rukun Negara yang berkait rapat dengan Perkara 3 ialah…

explanation.en: "Kepercayaan kepada Tuhan" reflects the place of religion in national life.
explanation.bm: "Kepercayaan kepada Tuhan" mencerminkan kedudukan agama dalam kehidupan negara.

prompt.en: Why is the "social contract" in the Constitution important for stability?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah "kontrak sosial" dalam Perlembagaan penting untuk kestabilan?

explanation.en: Citizenship for non-Malays was balanced with Malay special position, Islam and the Malay language.
explanation.bm: Kerakyatan untuk bukan Melayu diseimbangkan dengan kedudukan istimewa Melayu, Islam dan bahasa Melayu.

options.en: Each community accepted compromises, so questioning it carelessly can harm harmony
options.bm: Setiap kaum menerima tolak ansur, jadi mempersoalkannya secara melulu boleh menjejaskan keharmonian

options.en: It gives one race all the rights
options.bm: Ia memberi satu kaum semua hak

options.en: It can be changed by anyone at any time
options.bm: Boleh diubah sesiapa pada bila-bila masa

prompt.en: A state passes a law that goes against the Federal Constitution. What happens?
prompt.bm: Sebuah negeri meluluskan undang-undang yang bercanggah dengan Perlembagaan Persekutuan. Apakah yang berlaku?

explanation.en: Article 4: the Constitution is supreme.
explanation.bm: Perkara 4: Perlembagaan adalah tertinggi.

options.en: The law is void to the extent of the inconsistency
options.bm: Undang-undang itu terbatal setakat yang bercanggah

prompt.en: Why does Malaysia rotate the Yang di-Pertuan Agong among nine rulers every five years?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Malaysia menggilirkan Yang di-Pertuan Agong antara sembilan raja setiap lima tahun?

explanation.en: This unique rotation system balances the interests of the nine Malay states.
explanation.bm: Sistem penggiliran unik ini mengimbangi kepentingan sembilan negeri Melayu.

options.en: To share the highest position fairly among the Malay states
options.bm: Untuk berkongsi kedudukan tertinggi secara adil antara negeri-negeri Melayu

options.en: Because rulers are elected by the people
Because the British required it after 1990

prompt.en: As a student, how can you best respect the Constitution?
prompt.bm: Sebagai pelajar, bagaimanakah cara terbaik menghormati Perlembagaan?

explanation.en: Knowing and practising constitutional values strengthens unity.
explanation.bm: Memahami dan mengamalkan nilai perlembagaan mengukuhkan perpaduan.

options.en: Learn about it, obey the law and respect other communities' rights
options.bm: Mempelajarinya, mematuhi undang-undang dan menghormati hak kaum lain

options.en: Ignore it because it is old
Ask others to change it daily
options.bm: Meminta orang lain mengubahnya setiap hari
